notes.title: Little update, future of the game, what's happening?
notes.notes:
Hello, it's FlyingFantasy team.

We know the game has been dead silent for 3 years now, a lot of issues has happened in personal life of our team. However, we are glad to announce about our return and resumption of the work on the game! 


Until then, we plan to [b]release several smaller visual novels[/b] in the mean time! Please look forward to them!

-Moonie, FlyingFantasy

notes.title: The Demo is deactivated
notes.notes:
The Demo version of Treis Zoes is deactivated. We are currently doubt about the quality of narration. For the reason that our team is currently unable to support active development of Treis Zoes we temporarily deactivate the demo version of the game.

Development continues, but will go slowly. Players who have access to the Demo can play it as before. We will announce the activation of the Demo later.

And thank you for your feedback,
Flying Fantasy Team

notes.title: Minor update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, it's been a while, but we've been working hard on our game! We don't have major updates yet, so we will just slowly add minor updates for now!


1) We added the gallery and OST section
2) Changed the details a bit, removing few scenes from the story
3) Fixed minor errors
4) Improved the UI sound effects
5) Balanced the game sfx and the music

Hope everyone is doing okay in these hard times! Thank you for attention!

notes.title: Demo version update!
notes.notes:
The demo version of Treis Zoes has been updated!

-Treis Zoes d1.1-

Added:
-Now you can access the game center through the button in the menu.
-Information about the game in a seperate button.

Fixed:
-A little bit of optimization on the game's build size.
-Few slight changes in the text and visuals.
-Grammar errors.

The plans for the next update:
-Even more work on the optimization of the build.
-Gallery and soundtrack access.
-Even more music and CGs in the game.

Thank you for your attention, have a good day!

notes.title: Demo is now available!
notes.notes:
The demo version will take you in the life of Evanny, where you will find out about her motivations for going through the dangerous adventures, you will experience some drastic events that happens to her before the start of the journey.
Demo version also includes the ability to make choices on the progression of the story, that gives a little bit of replayability for you. 

Please, try out the demo version of our game and leave your feedback on it. We appreciate everyone's opinion.
